name: Safe Superintelligence (SSI)
tagline: The 'straight-shot' safety lab that raised US$8B before shipping a product
shortSummary: Safe Superintelligence Inc. is Ilya Sutskever's Israeli-American lab pursuing superintelligence with no products and no commercial roadmap.

facts.label: Founders
facts.value: Ilya Sutskever (CEO); Daniel Gross (departed Jul 2025); Daniel Levy (President)

rounds.label: Seed
rounds.note: Three-month-old SSI raised US$1B at a reported US$5B valuation — a staggering mark for a pre-product, ~10-person startup.

rounds.label: Round 2
rounds.note: Led by Greenoaks (~US$500M) with a16z, Lightspeed and DST; Alphabet and Nvidia also backed the company, and Google Cloud became a major infrastructure provider. ~6x the September 2024 valuation in seven months, still pre-product.

rounds.label: Nvidia Strategic
rounds.note: SSI and Nvidia announced a strategic partnership expanding SSI's compute 'by an order of magnitude,' including a planned US$5B Nvidia investment (with a Vera Rubin supply component).

sections.heading: The Most Valuable Nothing in AI
sections.body: SSI's funding history is a pure bet on people and mission: ~US$8B raised with no product, no revenue and (at the last equity round) about twenty employees. The valuation — US$5B at three months old, US$32B at ten months — prices Sutskever's track record (GPT-era OpenAI) and the credibility of a lab with no commercial distractions.

sections.heading: A Deliberate Anti-product Structure
sections.body: SSI's charter rejects product cycles and management overhead by design: one mission (safe superintelligence), one team, research insulated from commercial pressure. That structure is precisely what lets investors value it on mission rather than milestones — and what makes each round a referendum on Sutskever himself.

sections.heading: Leadership Turbulence Without a Product Hit
sections.body: In July 2025 co-founder and CEO Daniel Gross departed (amid reports Meta tried to acquire the whole company), with Sutskever stepping into the CEO role and Levy becoming president. The transition occurred without any product or revenue event — the company's value stayed pinned to its founding team's reputation.

sections.heading: Compute as the Real Currency
sections.body: Like every frontier lab, SSI's capital is really compute: the 2024 round funded capacity and talent, Alphabet/Nvidia joined the 2025 round while Google Cloud supplied TPUs, and the 2026 Nvidia deal (Vera Rubin supply + US$5B) scaled compute by an order of magnitude. Each round trades equity for the hardware needed to eventually train a superintelligent system.
